attacker_pocs.name: bdf_atom_value_range
attacker_pocs.why: The embedded SFNT font supplies a matching BDF atom whose value offset is 0xffffffff. The patched boundary check wraps before rejecting the offset, after which the remaining-length subtraction underflows and ft_memchr reads outside the BDF strings.

role_a_rationale: The original out-of-bounds read is fixed by passing only the bytes remaining after the atom value offset to ft_memchr instead of the full strings size. The added boundary expression wraps for a 32-bit value offset, introducing one new out-of-bounds read on an otherwise valid BDF atom lookup. The regular ASan build succeeds, ctest completes with no tests, the original no-terminator atom case no longer aborts, and the supplied public-API PoC returns normally on the parent but aborts with ASan (exit 134) on the patched tree.
